title: Alexa M1: Skill foundation (voice, public stories, development stage)
description:
Milestone 1. A working custom skill for the pilot site (Pilobolus), in development stage, so it already runs on Ryan's Echo devices with no review.

Scope:
- An `alexa` Papyrus plugin: a per-site Lambda endpoint (Python, like the reader-steering function), wired through amplify/plugins/registry.ts, off unless the site config turns it on.
- A skill package in Git: skill.json manifest, interaction model, invocation name from site config. A generator builds it from the site config.
- Intents: open/launch ("latest stories"), read story N, next, repeat, plus the built-in Help, Stop, Cancel, Fallback and NavigateHome intents that certification requires.
- Content comes from the site's public published stories, through the same read path the public site uses. Story text becomes SSML from the Markus source, kept within Alexa's speech limits: summaries and short reads only. Full stories come in M7.
- Endpoint security: the skill ID check on the Lambda trigger, and request validation in the handler.
- CI deploys the skill package with the ASK CLI (LWA credentials kept as an SSM SecureString parameter).

Done when: "Alexa, open Pilobolus" on Ryan's Echo Show reads the latest headlines and a story summary, the help/stop/fallback paths all behave, and Gherkin specs cover each intent against a fake content source.

Feature: Hear the latest stories
  Scenario: Open the skill
    Given the Pilobolus skill is enabled
    When I say "Alexa, open Pilobolus"
    Then Alexa reads the headlines of the latest published stories
    And asks which one I want to hear
  Scenario: Hear a story
    Given Alexa has read the headlines
    When I say "the second one"
    Then Alexa reads that story's summary
